Lemon drizzle cake

Beat 225 g soft butter with 225 g caster sugar, add 4 eggs one by one, fold in 275 g self-raising flour and the zest of 2 lemons. Bake 45 minutes at 180 °C. Mix the juice of 1.5 lemons with 85 g sugar and pour over the warm cake.

Make a paste of 4 tablespoons of baking soda and a little water, spread it inside the cold oven, leave it overnight, then wipe with a damp cloth and a splash of vinegar.
